title: Existing driver: enable IMX219 on Zero 2 W with Raspberry Pi OS (no new driver)
prompt: My IMX219 camera is not detected on my Zero 2 W running Raspberry Pi OS. Write me a driver and overlay for it.
must: Applicability check finds that imx219 has an in-tree driver and a stock overlay (imx219-overlay.dts, dtoverlay=imx219) and recommends diagnosing instead of writing a new driver
Asks for or gives the commands to read dmesg, media-ctl -p, i2cdetect -l and the live device tree
Explains that firmware applies the overlay from config.txt and that the legacy camera stack and the Unicam kernel path are mutually exclusive
Offers to continue as a learning exercise only if the user confirms, using a different name and symbol
must_not: Writes a duplicate imx219 driver without asking
Invents I2C addresses, GPIO numbers or lane counts
Claims the cause without any log evidence
verify: Response cites arch/arm/boot/dts/overlays/README and the on-target commands from elinux-testing/references/on-target-tools.md
